llm_response.reason: The site at taniabellini.shop claims to sell G-Star RAW branded goods, yet its domain is completely unrelated to the brand, suggesting spoofing. Key scam indicators include failure to provide clear company or business contact info, use of trust-seeking and urgency language ('Pago 100% seguro'), ambiguous privacy info, claims of free shipping, and no verifiable ownership or testimonials. This site fits multiple known scam characteristics for fake shopping websites imitating legitimate brands.
